purpose: Test whether deterministic deployment-registry schema-risk diagnostics over M0 and REOBSERVE_DIRECT separate useful from harmful SUPPLY_UNION_STRIPPED returns on the already-exposed A2T-G1-104 cohort.

predecessor.verdict: direct consistency relation was live but reward-inseparable; both registered policies chose STOP_M0 on 104 of 104
predecessor.measured_reason_for_successor: the prior state compared response structure but did not validate required versus optional parameters, JSON value types, or explicit deployment-registry enum and numeric constraints

prior_evidence_constraint.finding: the frozen core is not a safe menu arbitrator among supplied candidates
prior_evidence_constraint.consequence: this experiment uses deterministic external schema validation and does not ask the core to select among candidate tool rows

single_variable_change.changed: replace the prior pairwise-consistency state with a deterministic schema-risk state computed from both direct responses and the deployment registry
unchanged: zero parameter training and zero new model contact

population.exposure_status: fully exposed secondary discovery; no row, state, or fold is fresh support
population.group_id: receipt query_idx recovered from the pinned parent receipt

schema_parser.signature_grammar: toolName(name: Type, optionalName: Type?) with comma-separated scalar, List<T>, or Map parameter types; any ambiguity becomes unresolved
schema_parser.required_parameter: a declared parameter whose type lacks a terminal question mark
schema_parser.optional_parameter: a declared parameter whose type has a terminal question mark

type_families.Float: JSON integer or float excluding boolean

schema_parser.constraint_grammar: zero or more name: [body] clauses; a body is checked only when it is an exact enum list or a single numeric inclusive range
schema_parser.numeric_ranges: inclusive; supports integers, decimals, negatives, optional whitespace, and zero-padded endpoints
schema_parser.enum_comparison: exact string equality after trimming registry delimiter whitespace
schema_parser.unparseable_signature_or_constraint: explicit unresolved or uncheckable state; never guessed and never counted as a violation

per_response: parse class: invalid, empty, single, or multiple
registry resolution: all-known, some-unknown, or all-unknown
required-key coverage: complete, missing, mixed, or unresolved
unknown-key status: none, present, mixed, or unresolved
JSON type status: valid, invalid, mixed, or unresolved
explicit constraint status: valid, invalid, mixed, unconstrained, or unresolved
pairwise: risk relation: exact, M0-lower, observation-lower, incomparable, or unresolved
bucketed total violation counts for each response

candidates.schema-risk-coarse-v1: M0 risk class plus pairwise risk relation
candidates.schema-risk-detailed-v1: both response risk classes, pairwise risk relation, and both violation-count buckets

runtime_state.multiple_call_aggregation: aggregate unordered per-call statuses; call order and duplicate identical calls do not change state
allowed: M0 and REOBSERVE_DIRECT parsed call structure
literal predicted JSON argument values only for type and constraint validation
forbidden: reference transcript or spoken query text
sample id, query_idx, rendition id, or tier as a feature
tool name, tool id, domain, category, or description as a feature
literal argument values in the state key
invariances: renaming tools while preserving their schemas and response references

memory_policy.type: five-fold whole-query-group cross-fitted exact-cell non-parametric action-return memory
memory_policy.decision: choose SUPPLY_UNION_STRIPPED only when supply is available and the other-fold matching schema-risk cell has at least 4 samples, at least 2 observed saves, and zero observed harms; otherwise choose STOP_M0
memory_policy.candidate_selection: among candidates passing every gate, maximize cross-fitted exact-match net gain, then saves, then minimize supply contacts, then choose lexical candidate id

crossfit.assignment: reuse the predecessor's deterministic balanced whole-query-group assignment exactly

decision_ladder.failure: write a negative artifact and close schema-risk targeting for the current supply action; the next method must change information acquisition or supply generation rather than add another state category or relax a threshold
decision_ladder.success: freeze exactly one schema-risk controller proposal for a separately preregistered fresh approximately-100-sample exposed-discovery AgentLoop support flight
decision_ladder.support_success: only a stable prospective gain may propose a larger discovery experiment; no test or G2 access follows directly
